commands.result: All four author tests passed independently.
19 independent target probes passed for input/lexical behavior and observed documented resource-diagnostic omission.

findings.problem: Capacity errors omit observed actual value and configured capacity. Confirmed source overflow, source-count overflow, assembly-count overflow and decode-buffer overflow all emit only I_LIMIT file=... byte=.... Manifest/assembly-byte read overflow follows the same input::read path. This does not satisfy bootstrap-v1 §7/§13.2 resource-limit diagnostic requirement retained by H2.
findings.required_change: Include observed actual and capacity for manifest/source/assembly byte limits, source/assembly item limits and decode output capacity, while preserving relevant FileId/byte offset. A bounded reader may explicitly report its observed lower bound cap+1 instead of reading an unbounded file. Extend meaningful tests to assert values; do not weaken limit semantics.

verified_behavior: Exact 4 MiB source accepted and one byte over rejected; source 33 and assembly 9 rejected.
Invalid UTF-8 surrogate/overlong/out-of-range/truncation and BOM rejected; UTF-8 inside string/comment accepted.
Assembly bytes are genuinely retained by input snapshot and available to a target program.
Alternating EINTR and at-most-three-byte reads/writes preserve complete output and diagnostics.
Read error, zero-progress write, partial output followed by write error, and fchmod error all exit 1 and leave no output.
Existing dangling symlink and input hardlink output are rejected without overwrite.
nonblocking_notes: Rejecting 1__2 follows reference-next §2 and deliberately corrects an existing C0 lexer acceptance bug; document this mismatch in final differential results.
All other inspected L contracts and H2 shared API match. No other blocker found in this review.
